sections.text:
Work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category
Wear safety helmet, safety shoes, safety belt
Safety robe and precaution marks must be used
Switch off transformer from tow sides
Check the transformer ladder, fix it well

items: Suitable tool sets
Vacuum cleaner or blower
Pieces of soft cloths

Repeat the works that have be done according to MPIS 
 document No. T-044-r0

Inspect surface of transformer and gaskets and check oil 
 leakage, any leakage must be treated
Clean the bushings with soft clothes
Check oil level in bushings

Check and clean control cabinet of fan motor drive, using 
 video cleaner for connections, also inspect its gasket to be sealed
Cleaning and lubricating the fan bearings

Check and clean control cabinet of tap changer motor drive, 
 using video cleaner for connections, limit switch, contactors, etc...., also 
 inspect its gasket to be sealed
Check fans to be on (at 55 C) in oil temperature gauge
Check fans alarm (at 85 C) in oil temperature gauge
Check fans trip (at 95 C) in oil temperature gauge
Check fans to be on (at 65C) in winding temperature gauge
Check fans alarm (at 95 C) in winding temperature gauge
Check fans trip (at 105 C) in winding temperature gauge
Check tap-changer drive shaft
Clean the radiator and its accessories

Check the earthing system of the transformer and its 
 accessories (arrestors, earthing resistance, marshaling box, etc.)

Clean and grease the earthing - resistance switch and links 
 between its arms

Clean equipments connecting to earthing - resistance like 
 current transformer, arrester and porcelain insulators
Check all connections and retighten them
